name: Cartvai – Ecommerce Checkout, Funnel Builder & Shop Manager
author: cartvai

sections.description:
Cartvai is a complete standalone ecommerce plugin for WordPress — product shop, mini cart, one-page checkout, sales funnels, order management, customer records, and analytics — all in one lightweight plugin, without WooCommerce.

Build a full ecommerce store or a laser-focused sales funnel. Add a mini cart to any page. Display product grids with shortcodes. Run a one-page checkout. Manage orders, customers, and shipping from a clean admin dashboard. No WooCommerce required. No CartFlows required. No SaaS subscription.

If you’re looking for a WooCommerce alternative, a CartFlows alternative, or simply a faster and simpler way to sell online — Cartvai is built exactly for you.

🚀 Why Cartvai Instead of WooCommerce or CartFlows?

WooCommerce is powerful — but for many businesses, it’s overkill. CartFlows is great — but it requires WooCommerce underneath.

Cartvai gives you everything you actually need in one lightweight plugin:

  • ✅ Standalone — works without WooCommerce
  • ✅ One-page checkout optimized for conversions
  • ✅ Built-in sales funnels with product upsells
  • ✅ Order management, customer records, analytics
  • ✅ No per-transaction fees
  • ✅ 10× faster than a full WooCommerce store

⚡ Core Features

Sales Funnels

  • Unlimited sales funnels
  • Shortcode-based funnel embedding — works with Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg, and any page builder
  • Multiple checkout templates (choose the look that converts best for your audience)
  • Funnel-level product configuration (pricing, quantity, badges, images)
  • Funnel analytics — views, orders, conversion rate per funnel

One-Page Checkout

  • Fast, distraction-free single-page checkout
  • Cash on Delivery (COD) checkout built-in — ideal for South Asia, Middle East, Africa, and emerging markets
  • Customizable form fields (name, phone, address, district, notes, and more)
  • District/region select with 80+ country support
  • Mobile-first, responsive checkout layout
  • Trust badges and security icons
  • Multiple payment method support

Product Management

  • Unlimited products
  • Product variations (size, color, material, and any custom attribute)
  • Product image gallery with zoom
  • Product categories and tags
  • Sale price / regular price
  • Stock management
  • SKU support
  • Short description and full description
  • Variable products with attribute-based variation selectors

Order Management

  • Full order lifecycle management
  • Custom order statuses
  • Order detail view with customer info, items, shipping, notes
  • Inline quick-status update
  • CSV order export
  • Printable invoices
  • Fraud event telemetry

Customer Management

  • Customer database with order history
  • Customer detail view
  • Customer analytics

Analytics Dashboard

  • Revenue overview (today, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, all time)
  • Orders, customers, and conversion metrics
  • Funnel performance analytics
  • Product sales ranking
  • Exportable reports

Product Shortcodes (Page Builder Ready)

Embed any product element anywhere using shortcodes:

  • [cartvai_product] — full product layout
  • [cartvai_products] — responsive product grid
  • [cartvai_product_gallery] — image gallery
  • [cartvai_product_title] — product title
  • [cartvai_product_price] — price with sale badge
  • [cartvai_product_variations] — variation selector
  • [cartvai_product_actions] — Add to Cart + Buy Now buttons
  • [cartvai_product_trust] — trust badges
  • [cartvai_product_description] — full description
  • And 8 more individual element shortcodes

More Features

  • Google Tag Manager (GTM) integration
  • Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel) integration
  • Image optimization
  • REST API
  • Sitemap support
  • Mini cart widget
  • Import / Export (CSV)
  • Google Tag Manager noscript support
  • Translation ready (.pot file included)
  • Developer hooks and filters API
  • Clean, normalized database architecture
  • No external dependencies, no SaaS subscriptions

🎯 Perfect For

  • COD businesses — Cash on Delivery stores in Bangladesh, Pakistan, India, Egypt, Nigeria, and other markets
  • Single product sellers — One focused product, one optimized checkout page
  • Digital product creators — Courses, ebooks, templates, downloads
  • Physical product stores — Clothing, accessories, gadgets, handmade goods
  • Agencies — Build and manage funnels for multiple clients
  • Facebook & Google Ads — Landing page checkouts that convert ad traffic
  • Affiliate marketers — Product launch funnels and offer pages
  • Local businesses — Restaurants, services, local delivery
  • Drop shippers — Lightweight stores without WooCommerce overhead
  • Product launches — Time-limited campaigns and pre-order funnels
  • Anyone tired of WooCommerce complexity

🔌 Works With

  • Elementor
  • Divi Builder
  • Bricks Builder
  • Oxygen Builder
  • WPBakery
  • Gutenberg (Block Editor)
  • Any shortcode-compatible page builder

🛡️ Built to WordPress Standards

  • Follows WordPress Plugin Review guidelines
  • All output properly escaped
  • Nonce verification on all forms and AJAX
  • Capability checks on all admin actions
  • Sanitization on all inputs
  • No external API calls required
  • GPL-2.0-or-later licensed

Shortcodes

Cartvai includes a full product element shortcode system. All shortcodes are compatible with any WordPress page builder.

Full Product Layout

[cartvai_product] — renders the complete product page (gallery, title, price, variations, actions, trust badges, description).

[cartvai_product id="123"] — render a specific product by post ID.

[cartvai_product slug="my-product"] — render by slug.

Product Grid

[cartvai_products] — renders a responsive product grid.

[cartvai_products category="featured" limit="6" columns="3"]

[cartvai_products ids="12,34,56" columns="3"]

Attributes: category, categories, ids, limit, columns (1–6), orderby (date/title/price/stock/rand), order (ASC/DESC), offset, class.

Individual Element Shortcodes

Element

Price + sale badge

Short description

Variation selector

Stock status

Quantity input

Add to Cart + Buy Now

Buy Now only

Trust badges

[cartvai_product_description]
Full description

All element shortcodes support id, slug, suffix, and respect_settings attributes.

Product Scope Wrapper

[cartvai_product_wrap id="123"] … `[/cartvai_product_wrap]`

Wraps child shortcodes in a product scope — child elements resolve to the wrapped product without needing explicit id or slug on each one.

Developer API

Register custom product elements (for addons / Pro versions):

CARTVAI_Product_Elements::register( 'my_element', [ 'callback' => [ 'My_Class', 'render' ], 'shortcode' => true ] );

Hooks: cartvai_loaded, cartvai_register_product_elements, cartvai_product_element_before_render, cartvai_product_element_after_render, cartvai_product_element_output.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Cartvai.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now, then Activate.

Getting Started

  1. Open Cartvai from the WordPress admin menu.
  2. Go to Products → create your first product (add title, images, price, variations if needed).
  3. Go to Funnels → create a new funnel and add your product.
  4. Copy the generated shortcode (e.g. [cartvai_funnel id="1"]).
  5. Paste the shortcode on any page or landing page.
  6. Go to Settings → configure your shop name, currency, checkout fields, and payment methods.
  7. Start selling.
sections.faq:
Does Cartvai require WooCommerce?

No. Cartvai is completely standalone and does not require WooCommerce or any other ecommerce plugin.

Is Cartvai a WooCommerce alternative?

Yes. Cartvai is designed as a lightweight, conversion-focused alternative to WooCommerce for businesses that want to sell products through dedicated funnels without the complexity of a full ecommerce store.

Is Cartvai a CartFlows alternative?

Cartvai serves a similar purpose to CartFlows but does not require WooCommerce. If you want one-page checkout and sales funnels without building on top of WooCommerce, Cartvai is built for that use case.

What payment methods are supported?

Cartvai currently supports Cash on Delivery (COD) — the most popular payment method in South Asia, Middle East, Africa, and many other emerging markets. Additional payment gateways are planned for future releases.

Does Cartvai support product variations?

Yes. You can create variable products with any number of attributes (size, color, material, etc.) and manage variations with individual prices and stock levels.

Can I use Cartvai with Elementor, Divi, or other page builders?

Yes. Cartvai uses shortcodes that work inside any page builder. Place [cartvai_product], [cartvai_products], or individual element shortcodes in any widget or section.

Can I create unlimited products and funnels?

Yes. There are no limits on the number of products, categories, or sales funnels you can create.

Does it include order management?

Yes. Orders are stored in your WordPress database with full customer details, line items, shipping info, order notes, and custom statuses. You can also print invoices and export orders to CSV.

Does it include analytics?

Yes. The built-in analytics dashboard shows revenue, order volume, conversion rates, funnel performance, and product sales rankings across multiple timeframes.

Does it support multiple countries?

Yes. Cartvai includes district/region data for 80+ countries including Bangladesh, Pakistan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Egypt, Nigeria, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and many more.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. Cartvai includes a .pot file and is fully compatible with WPML, Polylang, and WordPress translation workflows. Text domain: cartvai-ecommerce.

Does it support Google Tag Manager or Facebook Pixel?

Yes. Cartvai includes built-in GTM and Meta Pixel (Facebook Pixel) integration with proper event tracking.

Is it GDPR friendly?

Cartvai stores customer data only in your own WordPress database. No data is sent to external servers.

Can I export orders?

Yes. Orders can be exported to CSV from the Orders screen.

How do I get support?

Visit cartvai.com for documentation and support.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Full WordPress Plugin Review compliance pass — all output properly escaped, nonces verified, capabilities checked.
  • PHPCBF auto-format: 66,000+ coding style fixes across 150 files (tabs, spacing, bracket formatting).
  • Added phpcs:ignore annotation on standalone invoice template (wp_enqueue_style not applicable for standalone HTML output).
  • Version bump to 2.0.0 reflecting the major compliance and quality milestone.

1.1.0

  • New extensible Product Elements API (CARTVAI_Product_Elements) with shared registry for core and third-party elements.
  • New [cartvai_products] shortcode — product grid with category filtering, ID selection, columns, orderby, limit, offset.
  • New [cartvai_product] full layout shortcode and [cartvai_product_wrap] scope container.
  • 14 individual element shortcodes — embed any product element anywhere.
  • Auto-shortcode registration for third-party extensions via 'shortcode' => true.
  • Product resolution handles explicit ID, slug, and current-page context.
  • DOM ID collision prevention via suffix attribute.
  • Render tracking for conditional asset loading.
  • Variation listing now uses paged queries instead of loading all at once.
  • Extended HTML whitelist with table, media, form, and interactive elements.
  • Fixed stored XSS vector in product attribute edit handler.
  • Fixed shipping district JS localization.
  • ABSPATH guards added to all template files.

1.0.1

  • Security hardening across admin handlers, AJAX endpoints, and templates.
  • Fixed admin asset loading on Cartvai submenu pages.
  • Database migrations now version-gated instead of running on every admin request.
  • Added Chart.js license attribution.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Standalone funnel system (no WooCommerce required).
  • Product management with categories.
  • Unlimited sales funnels.
  • One-page checkout with Cash on Delivery.
  • Customer and order management.
  • Sales analytics dashboard.
  • CSV export.
  • Shortcode support.
  • Mobile-friendly checkout.
  • Developer hooks and filters.
